name: Plaza del sol
demographics: Plaza del Sol serves a diverse, middle-income demographic in the Burbank area, attracting families and working professionals from the surrounding San Fernando Valley communities. The trade area encompasses a mix of homeowners and renters with household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $90,000 annually, with a significant Hispanic population alongside diverse ethnic groups. Primary shoppers include value-conscious families seeking convenient access to everyday retail and services, with strong weekday traffic from local workers and weekend family shopping trips.
description: Plaza del Sol is a well-established community shopping center located at 10950 Sherman Way in Burbank, California, serving the San Fernando Valley with convenient retail and services. This open-air center has been a neighborhood staple for decades, providing local residents with accessible shopping options in a practical layout. With operating hours from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM daily, the center accommodates both early morning shoppers and evening visitors. The property maintains a solid 4.3-star rating from over 1,374 reviews, reflecting its consistent service to the community. Managed by Perform Properties, a company focused on community-oriented retail centers, Plaza del Sol continues to serve as a reliable shopping destination for Burbank families and professionals seeking everyday conveniences.
summary: Plaza del Sol is a community shopping center in Burbank serving the San Fernando Valley with convenient retail and services. Operating daily from 7 AM to 10 PM, this neighborhood center maintains strong community ties with a 4.3-star rating from over 1,300 reviews.
